title: Energy System Transitions
description: Theoretical and applied topics in modelling of energy system transitions. Modelling; engineering, economics, policy and historical perspectives. The evolution of modelling approaches culminating in the existing modelling landscape. Integrated assessment modelling as a frame for broader implications in energy-climate work.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 566, CIVE 580 (if taken in the same topic)
